invariants: Bulk commands preserve the input Show and expose only a fully accepted candidate or typed refusal.

Shared instance edits preserve ownership, coalesce compatible writes, refuse conflicts, and report original-to-final impact without duplicate linked Clips.
Valid no-ops preserve record identity/timestamps and produce no adoption, save or history entry.

Placement-owned versus shared-instance settings; disjoint/identical/conflicting shared writes; direct and additional linked impact.

Adopt a bulk candidate, Undo once, Redo once; separately reject stale delivery and observe save rollback.
oracles: Public command outcomes and whole original/final Show records, not helper implementation details.
Production authenticated MCP tool/resource discovery and actual structured command results.
